events.title: v0.5.2 - NARNOK has shop offers
events.summary: April 2026 Shops now have much clearer identity, more ways to shape their offers over time and trigger rerolls. The overall NARNOK economy has been tuned to build more slowly and consistently. This release also folds in a follow-up pass on Booster payoffs, stacked home-node floor bonuses, and controller-friendly focus/navigation.Shops And OffersThe new shop sites are Hoffer, Lottahoffa, and Buuk.Hoffer adds more item offers to your shops after battle. Lottahoffa is the bigger shop-offer upgrade

events.title: v0.5 - NARNOK has cycles
events.summary: March 2026 v0.5 adds cycles, site combining, site discovery, and a new card batch.Win at tier `5` to complete a cycle. Each new cycle starts one tier lower: cycle `1` starts at `4`, cycle `2` starts at `3`, cycle `3` starts at `2` Cycle `1 -> 2` lets you keep `5` sites Cycle `2 -> 3` lets you keep `8` sites Win the last cycle to win the run!
